notes: COLLECTIONS ARE ORDERED BY LIFETIME VOLUME, NOT BY THIS WEEK. No marketplace states a Bitcoin collection's weekly volume -- UniSat's windowed endpoint answers an empty list for every window, its per-collection one takes no window, and Magic Eden's whole Bitcoin API answers nothing live (docs/phase9.md §11.1, §11.2). The week was asked for on this run anyway, and UniSat's own fills -- the only weekly figure obtainable anywhere -- named 4 collections over 66 fills in 7 days, which is not a top 50. So the collections are ordered by the whole history of a market and say so here, in `rankedBy`, in `ranking.collections` and on every screen. The runes below ARE this week's. Two lists, two windows, each said out loud: nothing here prints one as the other.

The runes are the 50 most-traded of the week that ord could resolve. UniSat ranked a pool of 80 tickers and the list was filled from the top of it in order, so a ticker ord could not resolve -- or resolved to a different rune id than UniSat named -- was made up from the next most-traded rune rather than leaving the list short. Nothing below a rune that was kept was promoted above it.
No rune carries a floor: UniSat's runes calls answered none, so the site prints no price for one rather than inventing a number no marketplace gave.
2 collections had no usable image and draw their carved monogram instead.
